desc: The Eradicator by Predator Tactics is a great choice for the budget minded hunter that is in need of a great predator hunting light or hog hunting light. The Eradicator comes equipped with intensity control, adjustable focus, silent remote switch, interchangeable LEDs and up to 300 yards of beam throw. The Eradicator Predator & Hog Gun Light will quickly attach to your scope with the included scope mount and have you out in the field chasing predators and hogs in no time. Includes universal scope mount, 18-650 li-ion battery and charger.
